headline: Grizzbolt minigun mount
title: Grizzbolt | Minigun Mount And Power Worker | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a mount that shoots in Palworld one point zero? Grizzbolt is a big Electric Pal, and you can ride it. Its partner skill, Yellow Tank, lets you rapidly fire a minigun while mounted. At your base it works Generating Electricity level five, Transporting level five, Handiwork level four and Lumbering level three. That makes it a strong all round worker. Would you ride it? Comment below!
description: Grizzbolt in Palworld 1.0 is a rideable Electric Pal with a mounted minigun and Electricity level five and Transporting level five.
